Wardrobe: emerald-green silk pantsuit worn over bare skin, gold cuff bracelets, patent loafers. @Image2 is LOGO REFERENCE — lime-green square with black squiggle: it replaces Franklin in the portrait oval of every custom bill in the vault. @Audio1 is the master track — the only audio.

LIPSYNC PROTOCOL — ABSOLUTE TOP PRIORITY: every vocal phrase = stable medium-close/close-up on thirds, lips tack-sharp, slow smooth camera; no cuts mid-phrase, no fisheye/whips during words; exaggerated articulation. Spectacle in gaps/background only.

STYLE: Doechii deadpan heist-luxe × Ariana gloss. Off-center.
Staging — an old-money bank vault: circular steel door, brass deposit boxes, gold bars on trolleys, bricks of squiggle-logo bills: 0–1s the vault wheel spins itself and the door swings open — she's revealed standing inside, chest-up, face right-third, line delivered through the opening. 1.5–2.5s "heads drop": two suited bankers outside the door bow in unison, soft focus. 2.5–3.5s "I collect": a trolley of gold bars rolls INTO frame bottom on its own. 3.5–4.5s "standing on the check": the floor reveal in a slow tilt — she stands on a giant engraved cheque inlaid in the marble floor, then straight back to her close-up before the next word. 4.5–10s slow dolly through the vault as she raps between walls of deposit boxes, bill bricks glowing lime in bokeh. 10.5–15s finale close-up against the gold shelf; on the instrumental a single squiggle bill drifts down past her shoulder; she doesn't blink. Continuity: gold pendant. Audio: @Audio1 only; vault clunks and trolley wheels in gaps. Quality bar: flawless lipsync, cinematic metal-and-gold light, no AI gloss.

Mise en scène — un coffre-fort de banque old-money : porte circulaire en acier, casiers de dépôt en laiton, lingots d’or sur des chariots, briques de billets au logo gribouillé : de 0 à 1 s la roue du coffre tourne toute seule et la porte s’ouvre — elle est révélée debout à l’intérieur, cadrée poitrine, visage sur le tiers droit, la ligne est délivrée à travers l’ouverture. Continuité : pendentif doré. Audio : @Audio1 uniquement ; bruits sourds du coffre et roues du chariot dans les pauses. LIPSYNC 协议——绝对最高优先级：每一句演唱 = 稳定的中近景/近景，三分构图，嘴唇清晰锐利，缓慢平滑运镜；句中不切镜头，唱词时不要鱼眼/甩镜；夸张咬字。华丽效果只出现在间隙/背景中。

VOCAL MAP：0–1 "...just got bars on a cracked phone" / 1.5–2.5 "I walk in, heads drop, that's respect" / 2.5–3.5 "I don't chase what's mine, I collect" / 3.5–4.5 "If I said it then I'm standing on the check" / 4.5–5.5 "Say it with your chest or keep it on the deck" / 5.5–6 "Ay!" / 6–10 副歌继续 / 10.5–14.5 继续推进到结尾 / 14.5–15 纯伴奏。

风格：Doechii 式面无表情劫案奢华 × Ariana 式光泽感。偏离中心构图。

场景调度——一间老钱风银行金库：圆形钢门、黄铜保管箱、推车上的金条、印有波浪线 logo 的钞票砖：0–1 秒金库转轮自行旋转，门向外打开——她站在里面被揭示出来，胸部以上入镜，脸位于右侧三分线，通过门缝完成台词。1.5–2.5 秒“heads drop”：门外两名穿西装的银行家同步鞠躬，虚焦。2.5–3.5 秒“I collect”：一辆装着金条的推车自行滚入画面底部。3.5–4.5 秒“standing on the check”：镜头缓慢下倾揭示——她站在镶嵌在大理石地面上的一张巨型雕刻支票上，然后在下一词前立刻回到近景。4.5–10 秒镜头缓慢推轨穿过金库，她在一排排保管箱之间说唱，钞票砖在散景中泛着酸橙绿光。10.5–15 秒结尾近景贴着金色货架；在纯伴奏段，一张带波浪线的钞票从她肩旁飘落；她不眨眼。连续性：金色吊坠。音频：仅用 @Audio1；间隙里有金库金属碰撞声和推车轮声。质量标准：完美 lipsync，电影感金属与金色光线，没有 AI 质感。
